text: This report responds to a Council request in December 2021 for the Executive Director, Environment and Energy to provide a status report on the implementation of Pocket Plus, the next phase of the Pocket Change Neighbourhood Climate Action to the April 26, 2022 meeting of Infrastructure and Environment Committee. The City is supporting the Pocket Plus project, as a neighbourhood scale implementation of TransformTO, Toronto's Net-Zero Strategy by 2040, with efforts to leverage institutional assets and expertise, along with scaling-up activities by residents to reduce emissions in the neighbourhood and maximize opportunities for environmental transformation. The Environment and Energy Division led the coordination of institutional stakeholders by organizing regular discussions and supporting partner organizations in the review of capital budgets, the evaluation of asset conditions, and…
The Infrastructure and Environment Committee received the report (April 8, 2022) from the Executive Director, Environment and Energy for information.
